title: Physical-Model-First Design
summary: Data structures are designed directly as database tables, skipping the conceptual, semantic and information layers.
body_markdown:
# Physical-Model-First Design

## Problem

Design starts with `CREATE TABLE`. Meaning, scope and history requirements are implicit in the physical design.

## Symptoms

- No conceptual or information model exists; ER diagrams are reverse-engineered.
- Technology choices dictate business definitions.

## Root Causes

- Developer-led delivery without architecture roles; tools that start physical.

## Consequences

- Semantic drift; hard-to-change history mechanisms; poor reuse.

## Detection

- Models exist only at physical level; no concept links.

## Remediation

- Introduce lightweight conceptual and information models for shared data; add traceability.

## Alternative Patterns

[[Concept-to-Model Traceability]].

## When It May Be Acceptable

Technical/internal data with no semantic sharing; prototypes that will be redesigned.
